name: busa-product-hub
description: Product & certification hub for export/trade sellers: catalog/SKU master data, pricing, inventory, channel status (Amazon/Shopify/TikTok Shop/eBay), content readiness, compliance notes, lifecycle state, a certificate expiry tracker (CE/FCC/RoHS/UN38.3/UKCA), and an approval-gated review queue (channel publish approvals, price-change review, quality holds, lifecycle decisions, and unsourced spec claims). The AirApp itself only ever decides on a review item (approve/request_changes/block) directly onto its own record -- it never creates a product, channel, inventory, or certificate row.

agentPrompts: Show me which certificates are expiring soon or already expired.
Summarize the latest products and flag what needs my attention.
Open Busa Product Hub and show me the items that need review.
